description: This file defines the WarningReportingUnit class and its nested Setting class, including JSON serialization, category management, and warning event reporting functionalities within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Main class managing warning reporting categories, cloning, and event reporting within the WarningReporting namespace.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit::Setting
classes.description: Represents configuration settings for warning categories, including JSON serialization support.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit::Setting::JSON
classes.description: JSON container class for serializing and deserializing WarningReportingUnit::Setting objects.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a warning reporting control for a specific category.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a category control to the internal list.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a category control from the internal list.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::GetCategories
methods.description: Returns a list of all category names.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific category, including default status, enabled state, excluded list, and configuration.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Defaults
methods.description: Gets or sets the default categories configuration in JSON format.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event with a specific identifier and information.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Instance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of WarningReportingUnit.
